Privacy policy

Azra Eateries respects your privacy and handles personal data in line with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019.

What we collect

This website has no accounts or forms. When you tap an inquiry button, WhatsApp opens and you send us a message directly. We then see your phone number and the message you choose to send.

How we use it

We use your WhatsApp details only to answer your questions and handle your orders. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.

Third parties

WhatsApp (Meta) processes messages under its own privacy policy.

Your rights

You can ask us to view, correct or delete your messages by contacting reception on 0757 927 486.

Cookie policy

Cookies and similar storage are small files saved in your browser.

What we use

This site only stores your cookie choice so we do not ask you again. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

Third-party links

WhatsApp links open outside this site and may use their own cookies.

Control

You can clear stored data any time in your browser settings.

We only store your cookie preference, with no tracking or ads. Read our cookie policy.
